statements.quote: The board may renew the licence for six months only if the independent reviewer accepts the risk note.
statements.subject: permission-passage
statements.interpretation: The source describes conditional permission, not a recorded final approval.

qualifiers.text: only if the independent reviewer accepts the risk note

required_qualifier_literals: only if the independent reviewer accepts the risk note

statements.quote: The meeting discussion records an objection that the risk note is incomplete. It records no final renewal approval.
statements.subject: meeting-discussion
statements.interpretation: The record contains an objection and no final renewal approval.

statements.quote: Retain the six-month duration, reviewer condition and recorded objection whenever the recommendation is reused. This guidance does not establish that renewal was approved.
statements.subject: team-discussion
statements.interpretation: Carry the condition and objection when reusing the recommendation.

qualifiers.text: does not establish that renewal was approved

required_qualifier_literals: does not establish that renewal was approved

statements.quote: Use a decision note with five fields: status, conditions, recorded objections, missing evidence and next check.
statements.subject: decision-template
statements.interpretation: Use an explicit decision-note structure, with missing evidence and a next check.
